title: a-witness Mandate
description: What a person (the principal) has allowed an AI agent to do on their behalf for regulated financial products. Signed by the principal's wallet or app. Draft v0.1.

mandate_id.description: Globally unique id for this mandate.

principal.description: The person or business the agent acts for. Pseudonymous by design: no names, addresses or account numbers live in the mandate.

principal_ref.description: Opaque pseudonymous id, resolvable only by the principal's own wallet or the provider at point of sale.

support_needs_declared.description: True if the principal has said they want extra support (Consumer Duty vulnerability). The detail is never stored here; this flag only tells the agent and provider to slow down and offer help.

agent.description: Who is acting. Mirrors 'know your agent' ideas.

operator.description: Organisation or individual responsible for running the agent.

public_key_ref.description: Key id the agent will sign trace events with (e.g. a JWKS URL plus kid).

provider_allowlist.description: Optional. If present, the agent may only deal with these providers.

max_price.description: Most the agent may commit per product, per term: the premium for insurance, the deposit for savings.

min_aer.description: For savings: the lowest annual equivalent rate (AER) the agent may accept. Anything lower and it must stop and ask.

max_price_increase_pct.description: For renewals: the most the price may rise versus last term before the agent must stop and ask.

max_transactions.description: How many binding actions this mandate allows in total.

requirements.description: Plain-language must-haves the principal stated, e.g. 'excess no more than 250 GBP'. Kept verbatim so a reviewer can check the agent honoured them.

machine_check.description: Optional structured version of the requirement for automatic checking.

human_confirmation.description: When the agent must get a live yes from the principal before a binding action. 'never' is allowed by the schema but verifiers will flag it.

terms_hash.description: Hash of the exact wording the principal saw when granting this mandate.

revocation_url.description: Where a verifier can check whether the principal has revoked this mandate.

action.description: Something an agent can do for the principal. Shared with the trace schema.

product_class.description: A kind of regulated financial product. Shared with the trace schema.

percent.description: A percentage as a decimal string, e.g. "4.35" for 4.35%. A string, like money, to avoid float rounding. Shared with the trace schema.

amount.description: Decimal as a string to avoid float rounding.

signature.description: Detached JWS over the canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of the document with this field removed.
